Their faith was growing and their love increasing amid trials. How has your faith grown through difficulty?
Paul assures them that God will set things right. How does God's justice comfort the afflicted?
Paul prays God would make them worthy of his calling. What calling do you want to live up to?
Paul tells them not to be quickly shaken. What helps you stay steady when you hear alarming things?
God chose you to be saved and to share in Christ's glory. What does that mean to you?
Paul prays God would comfort their hearts and establish them. Where do you need comfort and strength?
"The Lord is faithful. He will establish you and guard you." Where do you need his protection?
"Do not grow weary in doing good." What good work are you tempted to give up on?
Paul prays the Lord of peace would give peace at all times in every way. Where do you need peace?
